measurement_note: Five repetitions per cell (three for stdlib wasm Release) on macOS arm64 (Apple M-series), release-built compiler at the commit after a0cc27e3 with tracing spans only, pinned LLVM 22.1.8. Cold means a fresh DREAM_PREFIX and project directory, not a flushed OS cache. Traced runs route LLVM tools and the system cc through a Python wrapper (adds roughly 30 ms per subprocess to wall time); plain runs use the default Zig linker driver and no -v tracing. phase_seconds are exclusive: nested compile_phase spans are subtracted from their parent. Cold wasm Release rows include a one-time Binaryen download (~50 s, reported under `artifacts`) because the isolated prefix has no toolchains. Raw absolute paths are omitted.

go_baseline.note: `scripts/bench.py go`: fresh GOCACHE per repetition, so cold includes compiling the Go standard library; CGO_ENABLED=0. `noopt` adds -gcflags=all=-N -l.

sample_attribution.method: macOS `sample` at 1 ms intervals on the edited build after a cold build in an isolated prefix, system cc linker driver. Counts are inclusive 1 ms samples of the whole process.
